_sources.error_budget: Agreed with the COO in workshop 3: at most 1 in 100 documents may reach the TMS with an error the pilot did not flag.
_sources.human_error_rate: Discovery time study: 60 documents keyed by the doc desk, double-checked; 2.1% had at least one keying error (see 01-discovery/interview-synthesis.md).
_sources.min_stp_rate: Below 50% straight-through the business case does not pay back within 24 months (04-business-case/cost-benefit-analysis.md).
_sources.min_threshold: Workshop 3 decision: the system may not guess silently. Fields read with an assumption (no unit, assumed kg = 0.60; ambiguous date, assumed day-first = 0.70) always go to a person, so the threshold can never sit at or below 0.70.

ranking.name: Customer e-mail triage and draft replies

ai_act.basis: Not in Annex III; does not interact with people or make decisions about them.

use_cases.name: Freight document intelligence
use_cases.problem: 11 clerks key about 4,000 documents a month by hand; 2.1% of documents have a keying error that surfaces later as rework, customs corrections or demurrage.
use_cases.summary: Read bills of lading, CMRs, invoices, packing lists and delivery orders; check them; post clean ones to the TMS and send the rest to a clerk with reasons.
use_cases.value_basis: Business case (04-business-case), capacity view, steady state.

ai_act.basis: Art. 50(1) applies if customers interact with an AI system directly; with an agent reviewing every draft, transparency is still good practice.

use_cases.name: Customer e-mail triage and draft replies
use_cases.problem: The customer service team of 7 answers about 9,000 e-mails a month; 55% are 'where is my shipment' questions answered from the TMS.
use_cases.summary: Classify incoming customer e-mails (status questions, changes, complaints), pull the shipment status from the TMS and draft a reply for the agent to send.
use_cases.value_basis: 9,000 e-mails/month, 55% status questions, 3 minutes saved each at EUR 34/hour, 60% adoption.

ai_act.basis: Not in Annex III. The declarant stays legally responsible for the declaration; financial error impact is the real risk.

use_cases.ai_type: LLM with retrieval over tariff and past rulings
use_cases.name: Customs classification assistant
use_cases.problem: New product lines need classification research (20-40 minutes each); wrong codes lead to duty corrections and audit findings.
use_cases.summary: Suggest HS codes for new products from invoice descriptions and past declarations, with the reasoning, for the customs declarant to confirm.
use_cases.value_basis: 1,800 new classifications/year, 18 minutes saved each, plus avoided corrections (customs lead estimate, wide range).

ai_act.basis: Internal use; staff are told they use an AI tool (AI literacy).

use_cases.name: Internal knowledge assistant
use_cases.problem: 340 customer work instructions on a shared drive, a third outdated; new staff ask colleagues, which interrupts the experienced ones.
use_cases.summary: Answer staff questions from work instructions, customer-specific procedures and SOPs, with links to the source.
use_cases.value_basis: Onboarding time and interruptions; soft value, HR and team leads' estimate.

ai_act.basis: No personal data, no decisions about people.

use_cases.name: ETA prediction and delay alerts
use_cases.problem: Planners check terminal sites and call carriers; customers learn about delays late.
use_cases.summary: Predict arrival times for vessels and trucks from AIS, terminal and traffic data; alert customers and planners when a shipment will be late.
use_cases.value_basis: Planner time and customer retention; requires data subscriptions not yet costed.

ai_act.basis: Forecasts volumes, not individuals. Would become high-risk if extended to allocating work to individuals (Annex III 4(b)).

use_cases.name: Warehouse volume forecasting for staffing
use_cases.problem: Temp staff are booked the day before at premium rates; volumes vary 40% week to week.
use_cases.summary: Forecast inbound and outbound volumes per day and shift, so the warehouse plans temporary staff earlier.

ai_act.basis: Plans vehicles and loads. Must not be used to evaluate drivers (that would be UC-08).

use_cases.name: Route and load optimisation
use_cases.problem: Planning takes two planners half a day; empty kilometres around 21%.
use_cases.summary: Plan daily routes and loads for the 60 own trucks with an optimisation solver, replacing the planners' spreadsheet.
use_cases.value_basis: 3 points fewer empty kilometres (fuel, tolls, driver hours), planner time.

ai_act.basis: Annex III point 4(b): AI to monitor and evaluate the performance and behaviour of persons in work relationships. Also needs works-council consultation under Belgian collective agreements on new technology and monitoring.

use_cases.name: Driver and warehouse performance monitoring
use_cases.problem: Raised by a vendor demo; management wants 'more insight into productivity'.
use_cases.summary: Score individual drivers and pickers on speed and behaviour from telematics and scanner data.

ai_act.basis: Business documents between companies; no decisions about people.

use_cases.name: Carrier invoice audit
use_cases.problem: About 1,400 carrier invoices a month are approved on a sample basis; finance estimates 1-2% overbilling.
use_cases.summary: Check subcontractor freight invoices against agreed rates and the actual transport; flag overcharges before payment.
use_cases.value_basis: 1.2% of EUR 7.5m subcontracted transport recovered, minus false positives handled by finance.

use_cases.ai_type: LLM drafting with retrieval over rate cards
use_cases.name: Quote and tender assistant
use_cases.problem: Sales answers about 120 requests for quotation a month; complex tenders take days and are often late.
use_cases.summary: Draft quotes and tender answers from rate cards, past quotes and capacity, for sales to check and send.
use_cases.value_basis: Sales time and a higher win rate on fast replies (sales director estimate).

controls: ISO/IEC 42001 7.3 Awareness
risks.mitigation: Co-designed review queue; pilot clerks as champions; written commitment on no redundancies; weekly numbers shared with the team.
risks.risk: Clerks distrust the system and re-key documents anyway, or work around it

controls: ISO/IEC 27001 A.8.16 Monitoring activities
ISO/IEC 42001 9.1 Monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation
risks.mitigation: Error budget of 1%; validation and cross-document rules; 5% random audit of straight-through documents; escape rate on the KPI dashboard; release gate before every change.
risks.risk: Wrong data reaches the TMS without a flag (error escape)

controls: ISO/IEC 27001 A.5.20 Addressing information security within supplier agreements
risks.mitigation: Vendor engaged in week 1; file-drop import as fallback (already supported for bookings).
risks.risk: TMS vendor delivers the document API late

controls: ISO/IEC 27001 A.8.32 Change management
ISO/IEC 42001 A.6 AI system life cycle
risks.mitigation: Provider behind the orchestration layer; pinned model version; evaluation gate runs before any switch; offline rules provider as degraded mode.
risks.risk: Model provider changes or retires the model; behaviour changes

controls: ISO/IEC 27001 A.5.23 Information security for use of cloud services
ISO/IEC 27001 A.5.34 Privacy and protection of PII
GDPR Art. 28
risks.mitigation: Commercial terms reviewed: no training on inputs, retention limits, processing region; vendor assessed in the ISMS supplier process; data minimised (OCR text only, no attachments beyond the document).
risks.risk: Customer data is retained or used for training by the AI vendor, or processed outside agreed regions

controls: ISO/IEC 27001 A.8.26 Application security requirements
OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications: LLM01
risks.mitigation: The model only extracts: no tools, no actions; output constrained by a JSON schema; every value re-parsed and validated by code; prompt tells the model to ignore instructions in documents.
risks.risk: A document contains text that tries to steer the model (prompt injection)

risks.mitigation: Cash view is the decision basis; attrition decision explicit and agreed; value tracked monthly per gate.
risks.risk: Freed hours are absorbed without measurable value

controls: ISO/IEC 27001 A.5.10 Acceptable use of information
ISO/IEC 27001 A.8.12 Data leakage prevention
ISO/IEC 27001 A.6.3 Information security awareness, education and training
risks.mitigation: AI policy; one sanctioned assistant inside Microsoft 365; literacy training; DLP rules for known chatbot domains.
risks.risk: Staff keep pasting customer data into public chatbots (shadow AI)

controls: EU AI Act Art. 6 and Annex III
ISO/IEC 42001 6.1.4 AI system impact assessment
risks.mitigation: AI inventory with a reclassification trigger on every scope change; UC-08 parked; works council informed of every new use case.
risks.risk: A use case drifts into a high-risk category (for example forecasting used to allocate work to individuals)

controls: Belgian collective agreement no. 39 (new technologies)
risks.mitigation: Information and consultation before go-live (week 1, 14, 30); no individual performance monitoring; jobs statement in writing.
risks.risk: Works council objects late and stops a roll-out

risks.mitigation: Partner support during year 1; runbook; champion paired on every change.

controls: ISO/IEC 42001 A.7 Data for AI systems
risks.mitigation: Shadow mode on real volume before go-live; gate G2 measured on real documents, not on the pilot sets; real labelled set built during review.
risks.risk: Pilot results do not hold on real documents

risks.mitigation: Cost per document tracked in the orchestration layer; budget alert at 150% of plan.
risks.risk: Model usage costs more than planned

controls: EU AI Act Art. 14 (human oversight, as good practice)
ISO/IEC 42001 A.9 Use of AI systems
risks.mitigation: Flagged fields need an explicit confirm or correct; reasons shown; audit sample includes reviewed documents; review speed outliers discussed, not punished.
risks.risk: Reviewers approve flagged fields without looking (automation bias)

risks.scale: Likelihood and impact 1-5; score = likelihood x impact; 12 and above is red.
